title: 反应后处理（下）

author_source: project/MIT Digital Lab Techniques Manual/06_Reaction Work-Up II/src.py

points.K2: 旋转蒸发仪：好用但有规矩
points.K8: 规则一：扎头发，不穿宽袖
points.K9: 头发、衣物、首饰远离电机
points.K10: 规则二：装液不超过一半
points.K13: 规则三：瓶里不能有固体
points.K14: 规则四：用干净的防溅球
points.K16: 规则五：先冷却冷凝管和接收瓶
points.K19: 规则六：先抽一点真空再旋转
points.K23: 取瓶：关电机、放真空、取夹子

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台旋转蒸发仪旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a rotary evaporator with a condenser, a water bath and a round-bottom flask, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲旋转蒸发仪的正确使用。

shots.scene: 七个编号空白圆牌排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Seven round blank badges in a row, each with a different small icon. No people.
shots.narration: 七条规矩，条条要记牢。

shots.scene: 阿杰披着长发、穿着宽松袖子，凑近旋转的烧瓶看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student with long loose hair and baggy sleeves leans close to a spinning flask on a rotary evaporator.
shots.narration: 阿杰凑得很近，看烧瓶转。

shots.scene: 头发被卷进旋转部件的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of loose hair being pulled into a spinning part, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 头发和袖子，可能被卷进去。

shots.scene: 小研递给阿杰发圈，帮他挽起袖子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles, hands the young male student a hair tie and helps roll up his sleeves.
shots.narration: 小研说：先把头发扎起来。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and nods.
shots.narration: 先认识部件，再学规矩。

shots.scene: 烧瓶里溶着样品的溶液，旁边是固体和油状物图标
shots.prompt_en: A flask of solution with a dissolved sample, next to icons of a solid and an oil drop. No people.
shots.narration: 做反应、过柱子，样品都溶在溶剂里。

shots.scene: 溶剂飘走，烧瓶底留下纯样品
shots.prompt_en: Solvent icons float away and a small amount of pure sample remains at the bottom of the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 最后要把溶剂去掉，拿到产物。

shots.section_title: 旋转蒸发仪：好用但有规矩
shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍旋转蒸发仪
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the frame of a rotary evaporator.
shots.narration: 旋转蒸发仪就是干这个的。
overlay: 旋转蒸发仪：好用但有规矩

shots.section_title: 旋转蒸发仪：好用但有规矩
shots.scene: 规则手册图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank rule book icon with a check list. No people.
shots.narration: 好用，但有几条规矩必须守。

shots.scene: 真空管连着仪器，压力表指针下降
shots.prompt_en: A vacuum hose connected to the evaporator, with a pressure gauge needle dropping. No people.
shots.narration: 真空管路让系统压力降低。

shots.scene: 温度计上的沸点刻度下移
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon whose boiling mark moves lower as a pressure arrow goes down. No people.
shots.narration: 压力低了，溶剂沸点也低了。

shots.scene: 烧瓶浸在热水浴里
shots.prompt_en: The round-bottom flask sits partly in a warm water bath. No people.
shots.narration: 热水浴给烧瓶加点热。

shots.scene: 蒸发带走热量的雪花图标
shots.prompt_en: Snowflake icons around an evaporating flask, with a small heat arrow from the bath. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸发会吸热，要补充热量。

shots.scene: 烧瓶和仪器之间的一个玻璃球，被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A glass bulb between the flask and the rest of the evaporator is highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 烧瓶接在防溅球上。

shots.scene: 液滴冲上来被球挡住
shots.prompt_en: Splashing droplets fly up and are caught inside the glass bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 万一冲料，样品不会跑进仪器里。

shots.scene: 电机带动烧瓶旋转，瓶壁上铺开一层液膜
shots.prompt_en: The motor spins the flask and a thin film of liquid spreads over the inside wall. No people.
shots.narration: 电机让烧瓶旋转，液体铺成薄膜。

shots.scene: 表面积变大的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Arrows showing a larger surface area and faster evaporation. No people.
shots.narration: 面积大了，蒸发就快。

shots.scene: 蒸气上升进冷凝管，变成液滴
shots.prompt_en: Vapor rises into a coiled condenser and turns into droplets. No people.
shots.narration: 冷凝管把溶剂蒸气冷凝下来。

shots.scene: 液滴流进接收瓶；样品留在烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: Droplets drip into a receiving flask while the sample stays in the round-bottom flask. No people.
shots.narration: 溶剂进接收瓶，样品留在烧瓶里。

shots.section_title: 规则一：扎头发，不穿宽袖
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第一块圆牌，上面画着发圈
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the first badge showing a hair tie icon.
shots.narration: 规则一：扎起头发，不穿宽松袖子。
overlay: 规则一：扎头发，不穿宽袖

shots.section_title: 规则一：扎头发，不穿宽袖
shots.scene: 旋转电机旁的警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A yellow warning triangle next to the spinning motor. No people.
shots.narration: 旋转电机是个安全隐患。

shots.section_title: 头发、衣物、首饰远离电机
shots.scene: 小研扎好头发、袖口收紧，站在适当距离外操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student with hair tied back and fitted cuffs operates the evaporator from a proper distance.
shots.narration: 别凑太近。
overlay: 头发、衣物、首饰远离电机

shots.section_title: 头发、衣物、首饰远离电机
shots.scene: 长发、围巾、项链靠近电机的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of long hair, a scarf and a necklace near the motor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 头发、衣服、首饰，都别靠近电机。

shots.section_title: 规则二：装液不超过一半
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第二块圆牌，上面画着半瓶液体
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the second badge showing a half-filled flask.
shots.narration: 规则二：烧瓶最多装一半。
overlay: 规则二：装液不超过一半

shots.scene: 装满的烧瓶图标被打叉，半瓶打勾
shots.prompt_en: A full flask crossed out with a red X next to a half-full flask with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 装满了，不会更快。

shots.scene: 液体猛地冲进防溅球
shots.prompt_en: Liquid suddenly surges up from the flask into the glass bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 反而容易暴沸，样品冲进防溅球。

shots.scene: 用溶剂冲洗防溅球，烧瓶里液体变多
shots.prompt_en: The glass bulb is rinsed with solvent, and the liquid level in the flask rises again. No people.
shots.narration: 还得冲洗防溅球，要蒸的更多了。

shots.section_title: 规则三：瓶里不能有固体
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第三块圆牌，上面是被划掉的颗粒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the third badge showing crossed-out particles.
shots.narration: 规则三：瓶里不能有固体。
overlay: 规则三：瓶里不能有固体

shots.section_title: 规则三：瓶里不能有固体
shots.scene: 瓶里的搅拌子和固体颗粒被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A flask with a stir bar and solid grains inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 搅拌子也不行，它们会引起暴沸。

shots.section_title: 规则四：用干净的防溅球
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第四块圆牌，上面是闪亮的玻璃球
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the fourth badge showing a sparkling glass bulb.
shots.narration: 规则四：用干净的防溅球。
overlay: 规则四：用干净的防溅球

shots.scene: 小研在水槽边清洗防溅球，再用溶剂冲洗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves and goggles, washes the glass bulb at a sink, then rinses it with solvent.
shots.narration: 用前洗净，再用溶剂冲一遍。

shots.scene: 球内残留的污渍混进样品的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of residue inside the bulb mixing into a sample, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别人的残留，可别混进你的样品。

shots.section_title: 规则五：先冷却冷凝管和接收瓶
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第五块圆牌，上面是雪花
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the fifth badge showing a snowflake.
shots.narration: 规则五：先冷却冷凝管和接收瓶。
overlay: 规则五：先冷却冷凝管和接收瓶

shots.scene: 冷水在冷凝管盘管里流动
shots.prompt_en: Cold water flows through the coil of the condenser, shown with blue arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 确认冷凝管里有冷水在循环。

shots.scene: 接收瓶放进冰桶
shots.prompt_en: The receiving flask sits inside a bucket of ice. No people.
shots.narration: 接收瓶放进冰浴，少让蒸气跑掉。

shots.scene: 小研用塑料夹把烧瓶夹在防溅球上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student attaches the half-filled flask to the glass bulb and snaps a plastic joint clip in place.
shots.narration: 用夹子把烧瓶牢牢夹在防溅球上。

shots.section_title: 规则六：先抽一点真空再旋转
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第六块圆牌，上面是真空表和旋转箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the sixth badge showing a gauge followed by a rotation arrow.
shots.narration: 规则六：先抽一点真空，再旋转。
overlay: 规则六：先抽一点真空再旋转

shots.section_title: 规则六：先抽一点真空再旋转
shots.scene: 烧瓶和防溅球滑落掉进水浴的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the flask and bulb slipping off and dropping into the water bath, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没真空吸住就转，烧瓶可能掉下去。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起第七块圆牌，上面是缓慢旋开的阀门
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the seventh badge showing a valve turning slowly.
shots.narration: 规则七：慢慢打开真空。

shots.scene: 烧瓶里小气泡平稳冒出
shots.prompt_en: Small bubbles rise gently and steadily in the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 盯住鼓泡，太猛就把真空调小。

shots.scene: 真空猛开、液体翻涌的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a valve thrown wide open and liquid foaming up violently, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 开得太快，也会暴沸。

shots.scene: 烧瓶降入热水浴旋转
shots.prompt_en: The spinning flask is lowered into the warm water bath. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸发稳定了，再把烧瓶放进水浴。

shots.scene: 结霜的烧瓶图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a frosted flask, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 这样不会结霜，速度也合适。

shots.scene: 烧瓶壁上留下一圈黏稠的样品
shots.prompt_en: A sticky ring of concentrated sample on the wall of the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸到样品变黏、贴在瓶壁上。

shots.scene: 瓶里析出白色固体
shots.prompt_en: White solid forms on the inside of the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 固体样品，蒸完通常会凝固。

shots.section_title: 取瓶：关电机、放真空、取夹子
shots.scene: 三个步骤图标：关电机、放气阀、松夹子
shots.prompt_en: Three step icons in order: a motor switch turned off, an air valve opening, a clip being released. No people.
shots.narration: 取瓶：先关电机，再放真空。
overlay: 取瓶：关电机、放真空、取夹子

shots.section_title: 取瓶：关电机、放真空、取夹子
shots.scene: 小研取下夹子，托住烧瓶取下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes the clip and lifts the flask off while supporting it with her hand.
shots.narration: 最后取下夹子，托住烧瓶。

shots.scene: 烧瓶接到高真空泵管路上
shots.prompt_en: The flask is connected to a high vacuum line. No people.
shots.narration: 还有一点残留溶剂？上高真空泵。

shots.scene: 七块圆牌依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The seven badges light up one by one beside the panda mascot.
shots.narration: 七条规则，再复习一遍。

shots.scene: 前三块圆牌：发圈、半瓶、无固体
shots.prompt_en: The first three badges: a hair tie, a half-full flask, crossed-out particles. No people.
shots.narration: 扎头发、装半瓶、不放固体。

shots.scene: 后四块圆牌：干净球、雪花、真空表、慢阀
shots.prompt_en: The last four badges: a clean bulb, a snowflake, a gauge before rotation, a slow valve. No people.
shots.narration: 球要净、先冷却、先真空、慢慢开。

shots.scene: 欣欣手捧空白讲义
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a thick blank lab manual.
shots.narration: 演示只是预习，讲义一定要读。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现发圈、半瓶烧瓶、搅拌子打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a hair tie, a half-full round flask and a crossed-out stir bar.
shots.narration: 扎发、半瓶、无固体。

shots.scene: 干净防溅球、冰桶、真空表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a clean glass bump trap, an ice bucket and a vacuum gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 球干净、先冷却、先真空再旋转。

shots.scene: 慢慢旋开的阀门和取瓶三步图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a slowly opening valve and three steps for removing the flask. No people.
shots.narration: 慢开真空，按顺序取瓶。

shots.scene: 瓶壁黏稠样品和高真空泵图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a flask with a sticky ring of sample and a high vacuum pump. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸到黏稠贴壁，残留再上高真空。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一只蒸干的烧瓶，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a flask with a dry sample ring and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 规矩记牢，旋蒸无忧，下次见！
